import pytest

from jinja2.nativetypes import NativeEnvironment


def test_issue_1701_nativetypes_block_loop_index_typeerror():
    """
    This test reproduces the TypeError: sequence item 0: expected str instance, int found
    when using NativeEnvironment with a block containing a loop that outputs loop.index
    and the block is called using self.block_name().
    """
    env = NativeEnvironment()
    template = env.from_string(
        '{% block test %}{% for i in range(1) %}{{ loop.index }}{% endfor %}{% endblock %}{{ self.test() }}'
    )
    with pytest.raises(TypeError) as excinfo:
        template.render()
    assert "sequence item 0: expected str instance, int found" in str(excinfo.value)
